title: "Idref harvester"

🧭 Back to [Harvesters Overview](overview.qmd)

## Data source

The IdRef harvester fetches data from the [IdRef SPARQL endpoint](https://data.idref.fr/sparql).

## Supported identifiers

- idref
- orcid

## Data conversion

IdRef document types are mapped to RDF classes, and author qualities are mapped to LoC roles, following the tables
provided in the
[CRISalid data model documentation](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1452441617).

## Sub-harvesters

When the data returned by the main IdRef harvester is not sufficient, IdRef harvester delegates to additional
sub-harvesters to gather more data:

| Sub-harvester | Source |
|---|---|
| OpenEdition | [OpenEdition OAI-PMH API](http://oai.openedition.org/?verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc) |
| Persée | Persée RDF endpoint |
| SciencePlus | SciencePlus RDF endpoint |
| SUDOC | SUDOC RDF endpoint |
